deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 8, 2026 at 11:59 PM EST (late letters or scores must still arrive by December 7).
deadline.quote: The deadline for submission of Ph.D. applications is December 8 at 11:59 PM EST

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but you may submit scores.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required at this time, but you are welcome to submit your scores if you have them.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is optional and used only as a point of information.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test (Institution code is 2926 and Department code is 0703) scores are optional for admission to our graduate program.

toefl_min.value: The department looks for a TOEFL total of at least 100 and at least 20 on speaking.
toefl_min.quote: On the TOEFL, we look for total scores of at least 100, and scores of at least 20 on the spoken English portion.

ielts_min.value: IELTS accepted in place of TOEFL with a minimum score of 7.
ielts_min.quote: a score on the IELTS--minimum score 7

english_waiver.value: A test is required unless the 4-year undergraduate degree was entirely in a country whose primary language is English, which does not cover India; the committee may also exempt applicants who have shown spoken English.
english_waiver.quote: unless their 4-year undergraduate studies were undertaken entirely in a country whose primary language is English

also.quote: those who have adequately demonstrated their spoken English skills to our admissions committee

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the committee, not by individual professors; do not ask faculty for admission.
supervisor.quote: Admissions decisions are determined by the Mathematics Graduate Admissions Committee, not by individual professors.

funding.value: Five-year support package with full tuition scholarship, fees, health insurance and stipend, provided good progress is made.
funding.quote: Ph.D. students are offered a five-year support package including a full tuition scholarship, coverage of fees, health insurance, and an annual stipend

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough to apply; a master's is not necessary.
entry_route.quote: a masters degree is not necessary in order to apply to our Ph.D. program

notes: The FAQ gives December 7 for the online application; the how-to-apply page and SAS calendar give December 8. Applied Math and Computational Science (AMCS) is a separate SAS graduate group and was not researched.
